name: adb-claw
description: Android device control CLI for Gemini 3.8 Flash Computer Use. Perception is a JPEG frame only. Actions use a 0-999 normalized coordinate grid.

model.name: gemini-3.8-flash
model.image: inline JPEG from frame path, never base64 in tool JSON

tools.name: take_screenshot
tools.description: Create a unique screen JPEG and frame token. Never looks at UI text nodes.
tools.returns: unique path, frame_token, hash, captured_at, rotation, action/image size
tools.when_to_use: Before deciding an action. Read the returned path and retain its frame_token.

tools.name: click
tools.description: Tap using Gemini Computer Use 0-999 coordinates.
tools.usage: adb-claw tap --normalized X Y --frame FRAME_TOKEN [--wait-changed 1500]   OR serve act {action:tap, frame_seq, x, y}
tools.when_to_use: After reading the latest frame. The one-shot CLI requires its frame_token.

tools.name: long_press
tools.when_to_use: For context menus or press-and-hold controls.

tools.name: scroll
tools.description: Scroll the screen. Prefer direction pages; swipe also accepts 0-999 endpoints.
tools.usage: adb-claw scroll {up|down|left|right} --frame FRAME_TOKEN [--pages N]   OR adb-claw swipe --normalized X1 Y1 X2 Y2 --frame FRAME_TOKEN
tools.when_to_use: To reveal more content after reading the current frame.

tools.name: type
tools.description: Type text into the focused field. Unicode uses embedded app_process ACTION_SET_TEXT; no APK or IME change.
tools.when_to_use: After clicking an editable field to focus it. Prefer a known deep link when it avoids UI steps.

tools.name: key
tools.when_to_use: Back, home, confirm, or device keys.

tools.name: open_app
tools.description: Launch an app or open a deep link / URL.
tools.usage: adb-claw app launch PACKAGE   OR adb-claw open URI
tools.when_to_use: To jump to an app or pass CJK text as a URL parameter.

tools.name: serve
tools.description: Persistent JSONL session: frame.latest / frame.wait_after / act / device.info.
tools.when_to_use: Gemini 3.8 Flash adapters. Image bytes stay on disk; JSON only has path + frame_seq.

tools.name: wait
tools.description: Wait for an activity or a visual screen change. No text locators.
tools.when_to_use: When an action ran without integrated --wait-changed. A changed wait returns a new JPEG path.

tools.name: bench
tools.description: Measure first frame, screenshot, latest write, and normalized tap latency.
tools.when_to_use: To collect a repeatable image-only latency baseline.

tools.name: app_current
tools.description: Get the currently focused app and activity.
tools.when_to_use: To load an App Profile or confirm navigation.

tools.name: device_info
tools.description: Get device details: model, screen size, Android version.
tools.when_to_use: At the start of a session.

workflow_hints.image_only: The only perception input is a JPEG file from observe or frame.latest. Do not request a UI tree.
workflow_hints.normalized_coords: All model actions use a 1000x1000 (0-999) grid plus the latest frame_token. Bare pixels and unbound normalized actions are rejected.
workflow_hints.stale_frame: STALE_FRAME means the screen changed or the frame aged out. Call frame.latest again before acting.
workflow_hints.no_sleep: Never insert sleep, time.sleep, adb-claw shell sleep, or a timed pause. Use an action's --wait-changed or wait --changed --after-frame.
workflow_hints.wait_after: One-shot CLI: an action with --wait-changed returns the next unique JPEG path. Without it, use wait --changed --after-frame. Serve uses frame.wait_after.
workflow_hints.unicode: Focus the field and call type. Unicode uses adb-claw's embedded app_process ACTION_SET_TEXT helper. Never install ADBKeyboard, change IME, or call the raw clipboard service.
workflow_hints.forbidden_shell: Never use shell for UI hierarchy extraction, layout/accessibility dumpsys, clipboard service calls, or IME changes. Use JPEG perception, app current, and type.
workflow_hints.retry_policy: Empty/error/placeholder screens are valid outcomes. Retry the same hash plus normalized point at most once; never switch to --raw, pull, a fixed path, or node inspection.
workflow_hints.usb_capture: A physical USB device uses auto/stream. Unique frame paths prevent adapter image caching; do not switch to pull for that symptom.
workflow_hints.media: Adapter default: gemini-3.8-flash, thinking_level=low, media_resolution=medium, inline JPEG. Upgrade to high only for dense small text.
workflow_hints.cjk: Prefer a known deep link to reduce steps; otherwise focus the field and use built-in Unicode type.
